name: What is the process for a custom trim installation project with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a custom trim installation project with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, inspect the space, and understand your design preferences. We then provide a detailed proposal and design recommendations. Once approved, we meticulously measure and prepare the area. Our skilled craftsmen fabricate and install the trim, ensuring precise cuts and seamless joins. Finally, we handle any necessary finishing work, such as sanding, priming, and painting or staining, leaving your space clean and transformed. Throughout the project, we maintain clear communication to ensure your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, proposal, design approval, precise fabrication and installation, and finishing work. We focus on clear communication.
